Class ObservablePlayerModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.ObservableGame.ObservablePlayerModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
DTOUpdatable<PlayerDTO>
public class ObservablePlayerModel extends Object implements DTOUpdatable<PlayerDTO>
Observable model representing a single player's state for the JavaFX GUI layer. Wraps a PlayerDTO into JavaFX observable properties, allowing UI components to bind directly and react automatically to player state changes.

    • updateFromDTO

      public void updateFromDTO(PlayerDTO dto)
      Updates this player model from the provided PlayerDTO. All scalar properties are updated directly. The tribe model is updated via its own updateFromDTO method, which internally checks for changes before modifying its lists.
      Specified by:
      updateFromDTO in interface DTOUpdatable<PlayerDTO>
      Parameters:
      dto - the DTO containing the updated player data; if null, no changes are made
